name: IndexTTS-2 (Bilibili)
blurb: Top-tier zero-shot cloning with emotion control (emotion reference clip, strength, or text-described mood). Heavier and slower than the other engines.

badge.tip: Heavy: designed for 12+ GB VRAM. On this 8 GB card it runs in fp16 but is slow and may OOM on long text — generate short passages. Also a large git-based install (multi-GB checkpoints).

params.label: Emotion strength
params.help: How strongly the emotion reference/description is applied. 1 = full.

params.label: Emotion (described in words)
params.help: Optional. e.g. 'excited and cheerful', 'tired and sad'. Leave blank to inherit the reference clip's emotion.

params.label: Pitch (semitones)
params.help: Shift the voice up/down, keeping timbre (TD-PSOLA).

params.label: Intonation range
params.help: How far pitch swings around its median: 0 = monotone, 1 = as generated, 1.5+ = expressive.
